from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json,hashlib,re,gc
import numpy as np
import torch
r=Path('/data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion')
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(4*1024*1024),b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def read(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
s=read(r/'results/shared_private_evidence_complete_20261001/SUMMARY.json')
c=r/'logs/shared_private_evidence_20261001_v2'
m=read(c/'manifest.json'); prior=read(Path(m['after_campaign'])/'manifest.json')
torch.set_num_threads(1)
hashes={}
for p,h in m['source_sha256'].items():
    actual=sha(r/p); assert actual==h,p
    hashes[p]=actual
assert all(sha(r/p)==h for p,h in prior['source_sha256'].items())
assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in s['source_artifacts_sha256'].items())
assert sha(r/'tools/report_shared_private_evidence_complete.py')==s['source_sha256']
for n,h in s['figure_sha256'].items(): assert sha(r/'results/shared_private_evidence_complete_20261001'/n)==h
print(json.dumps({'check':'sources','observed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'active':len(m['source_sha256']),'sealed':len(prior['source_sha256']),'source_artifacts':len(s['source_artifacts_sha256']),'summary_sha256':sha(r/'results/shared_private_evidence_complete_20261001/SUMMARY.json'),'manifest_sha256':sha(c/'manifest.json'),'report_and_figures_bound':True}),flush=True)
protocols={}
for name in ('RGBNT201','RGBNT100','MSVR310'):
    pp=r/f'logs/official_three_dataset_protocols_20260923/{name}.json'; p=read(pp); root=Path(p['dataset_root']); protocols[name]=p
    for split,rows in p['records'].items():
        assert len(rows)==p['counts'][split]
        actual_split=p[split+'_split']
        if name=='RGBNT201': actual_paths={str(x.relative_to(root)) for x in (root/actual_split/'RGB').glob('*.jpg')}
        elif name=='RGBNT100': actual_paths={str(x.relative_to(root)) for x in (root/'rgbir'/actual_split).glob('*.jpg')}
        else: actual_paths={str(x.relative_to(root)) for x in (root/actual_split).glob('*/vis/*') if x.is_file()}
        assert len(actual_paths)==len(rows) and actual_paths=={x['paths'][0] for x in rows},(name,split)
        assert [x['index'] for x in rows]==list(range(len(rows)))
        for row in rows:
            assert all((root/x).is_file() for x in row['paths'])
            f=Path(row['paths'][0]).name
            if name=='RGBNT201': identity=int(f.split('_')[0][:6]); camera=int(f.split('_')[1][3])-1; scene=camera
            elif name=='RGBNT100': identity,camera=map(int,re.search(r'([-\d]+)_c([-\d]+)',f).groups()); camera-=1; scene=camera
            else: identity=int(f[:4]); camera=int(f[11]); scene=int(f[6:9])
            assert (identity,camera,scene)==(row['identity'],row['camera'],row['scene'])
    tr,q,g=[p['records'][k] for k in ('train','query','gallery')]
    tid,qid,gid=[{x['identity'] for x in v} for v in (tr,q,g)]
    assert tid.isdisjoint(gid|qid)
    env=p['environment_key']; counts=Counter(x['identity'] for x in g); environments=Counter((x['identity'],x[env]) for x in g)
    positives=[counts[x['identity']]-environments[x['identity'],x[env]] for x in q]
    assert all(n>0 for n in positives)
    print(json.dumps({'check':'dataset','dataset':name,'protocol_sha256':sha(pp),'counts':p['counts'],'identity_counts':[len(tid),len(qid),len(gid)],'gallery_only_identity_count':len(gid-qid),'all_actual_paths_retained':True,'filename_label_parity':True,'positive_range':[min(positives),max(positives)],'split_identity_disjoint':True}),flush=True)
for row in s['rows']:
    run=Path(row['run_dir']); child=read(Path(row['campaign_dir'])/'campaign.json'); train=read(run/'training.json'); official=read(run/'official_metrics.json'); p=protocols[row['dataset']]
    binary={}
    for filename,key in (('best_map.pth','checkpoint_sha256'),('official_distances.pt','distance_sha256')):
        path=run/filename; h=sha(path); assert h==row[key]==official[key]; binary[str(path)]={'sha256':h,'bytes':path.stat().st_size}
    cp=torch.load(run/'best_map.pth',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    assert cp['metrics']==official['metrics'] and cp['epoch']==row['best_epoch']
    assert cp['dataset']==row['dataset'] and cp['seed']==42 and cp['condition']==official['condition']
    assert cp['protocol_sha256']==sha(r/f"logs/official_three_dataset_protocols_20260923/{row['dataset']}.json")
    state=cp['state']; vp='backbone.signal.clip_vision_encoder.base.'; visual={k:v for k,v in state.items() if k.startswith(vp)}
    assert len(visual)==152 and all(v.dtype==torch.float32 for v in visual.values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all().item() for v in state.values())
    baseline_path=Path(train['initializer']['author_checkpoint']); baseline_hash=sha(baseline_path)
    assert baseline_hash==cp['baseline_sha256']==official['baseline_sha256']==train['initializer']['author_checkpoint_sha256']
    baseline=torch.load(baseline_path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    nonvisual={k:v for k,v in state.items() if k.startswith('backbone.signal.') and not k.startswith(vp)}
    assert all(torch.equal(v,baseline[k.removeprefix('backbone.signal.')]) for k,v in nonvisual.items())
    assert any(not torch.equal(v,baseline[k.removeprefix('backbone.signal.')]) for k,v in visual.items())
    del baseline
    m0=Path(child['jobs'][0]['output_dir']); m0tr=read(m0/'training.json'); m0h=sha(m0/'m0_reload_probe.pth'); assert m0h==m0tr['m0']['reload_probe_sha256']
    probe=torch.load(m0/'m0_reload_probe.pth',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    assert set(probe['state'])==set(state)
    assert all(probe['state'][k].shape==v.shape and probe['state'][k].dtype==v.dtype for k,v in state.items())
    arrays=torch.load(run/'official_distances.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
    assert tuple(arrays['fused'].shape)==(p['counts']['query'],p['counts']['gallery']) and torch.isfinite(arrays['fused']).all().item()
    for split in ('query','gallery'):
        for field,key in (('ids','identity'),('cameras','camera'),('scenes','scene')):
            assert np.array_equal(arrays[split+'_'+field],np.array([x[key] for x in p['records'][split]]))
    print(json.dumps({'check':'saved_binaries','dataset':row['dataset'],'variant':row['variant'],'epoch':cp['epoch'],'full_state_tensors':len(state),'visual_fp32_tensors':len(visual),'frozen_nonvisual_tensors_equal':len(nonvisual),'m0_state_key_shape_dtype_parity':True,'m0_probe_sha256':m0h,'baseline_sha256':baseline_hash,'array_shape':list(arrays['fused'].shape),'array_label_fields_equal_protocol':True,'binary_hashes':binary}),flush=True)
    del cp,state,visual,nonvisual,probe,arrays
    gc.collect()
print(json.dumps({'check':'audit_read_only_complete','metric_functions_called':0,'neural_forwards':0,'optimizer_updates':0,'files_written':0,'binary_files_transferred':0}),flush=True)
